data.name: QueryContractSearchPurchaseOrders
data.value: Saved SQL batch; EXEC, WHILE and cursors are supported. Input: @RequestJson (Number, Supplier, Branch, Status, From, To). Output: one row and one ResultJson nvarchar(max) column containing a JSON array of headers: Id, Number, SupplierId, SupplierName, Branch, Status, Date (yyyy-MM-dd), CanEdit. Maximum 1,000 orders. Use read-only credentials. See docs/purchase-order-scripts.md.

data.name: QueryContractReadPurchaseOrder
data.value: Saved SQL batch; input @RequestJson (OrderId). Output: ResultJson containing Header, Revision and Lines. Each line: Id, ProductCode, Description, Unit, BaseUnit, Quantity, BaseUnitsPerUnit, UnitPrice, Total, ReceivedQuantity, IsCancelled. Revision must cover all relevant ERP state. Read within the supplied transaction without NOLOCK or transaction controls. See docs/purchase-order-scripts.md.

data.name: QueryContractCreatePurchaseOrder
data.value: Confirmed write batch with EXEC, WHILE or cursors. Input: @RequestJson containing the versioned OrderWritePlan, OperationId and selected Changes. Use the supplied transaction, ERP allocation, numbering, defaults and rounding rules. Save an idempotent external operation receipt in that transaction. Output ResultJson: OperationId, State (Committed), OrderId. Do not split orders. See docs/purchase-order-scripts.md.

data.name: QueryContractUpdatePurchaseOrder
data.value: Confirmed write batch. Input: @RequestJson containing ExpectedOrder and explicit per-line Changes. Null fields mean preserve the existing value. Recheck edit/receipt restrictions; maintain dependent fields and totals using ERP rules. Cancellation is explicit. Preserve unrelated lines. Save an external receipt in the supplied transaction. Output ResultJson: OperationId, State (Committed), OrderId. See docs/purchase-order-scripts.md.

data.name: QueryContractReconcilePurchaseOperation
data.value: Read-only saved batch; input @RequestJson with the original plan and OperationId. Check the durable external operation journal. Output ResultJson: OperationId, State (Committed, NotApplied or Unknown), OrderId (required for Committed). NotApplied requires proof that no in-flight operation can still commit. Never repeat the original write here. See docs/purchase-order-scripts.md.

data.name: QueryContractUpdatePurchaseSynchronization
data.value: Confirmed SynchronizationWritePlan in @RequestJson; @OperationId and @OperatorCode are typed parameters. Apply only the reviewed selection in the supplied transaction. Preserve unrelated fields and append a durable operation marker in existing storage. Return ResultJson with OperationId, State=Committed and OrderId. No schema or trigger changes.

data.name: QueryContractReconcilePurchaseSynchronization
data.value: Read-only SynchronizationWritePlan in @RequestJson. Check the recorded target/allocation, durable operation marker and resulting values. Return ResultJson with OperationId, State=Committed or Unknown, OrderId. An absent marker means Unknown. Never resend a write.

data.name: QueryContractReservePurchaseSynchronization
data.value: Create-only allocation for the confirmed SynchronizationWritePlan. Atomically reserve the displayed number through the validated ERP counter and controls from an existing sequence. No order inserts here. Return ResultJson: OrderId, Number, LineControls (one per selected line). Allocations are saved locally before dispatch and never reused.

data.name: QueryContractCreatePurchaseSynchronization
data.value: Confirmed SynchronizationWritePlan in @RequestJson includes the saved Allocation, Date and reviewed Selection. Set the initial status in the script; Status may be null. Insert only those reserved controls, apply validated ERP defaults and totals, and save a durable operation marker in the same transaction. Return ResultJson: OperationId, State=Committed, OrderId. No schema or trigger changes.

data.name: QueryContractPreviewPurchaseFinancials
data.value: Read-only SynchronizationWritePlan in @RequestJson with FinancialPolicy and frozen PDF captures. Return ResultJson: Status (Ready, MissingDocumentValues, MissingHistory, UnsupportedPolicy), Revision, HasChanges, Header (FinancialAmounts), OrderTotal, Lines (Position, Control, ProductCode, Unit, BaseUnit, Quantity, Factor, UnitPrice, ItemTotal, Values) and Sources (CatalogIdentity, OrderId, Revision, Date). Define totals, taxes, allocation and rounding in this query. Keep Revision deterministic. The result is approved and reread under the write transaction. Updated write/reconciliation scripts must honor FinancialPolicy/FinancialPreview. See docs/purchase-order-scripts.md.
